events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Częstochowa, Poland, to a Jewish family.

evidence.quote: He was born in 1903 in Częstochowa , Poland

events.text: Joined the Polish forces to fight the Bolsheviks.

evidence.quote: joined the Polish forces to fight the Bolsheviks in 1918

events.text: Earned a PhD in zoology at Jagiellonian University, Kraków.

evidence.quote: He earned a PhD in zoology at the Jagiellonian University in Kraków in 1929

events.text: Published a research report in Zeitschrift für Parapsychologie.

evidence.quote: He published a report in 1932 in a German journal called Zeitschrift für Parapsychologie

events.text: Freed from internment and chose to emigrate to the U.S.

evidence.quote: They were eventually freed and chose to emigrate to the U.S . in 1951

events.text: Emigrated with Wela to the United States, first Pennsylvania then New York.

evidence.quote: In 1952 , Imich and Wela ( who died in 1986 ) emigrated to the United States

events.label: career change
events.text: Turned to parapsychology after Wela began her psychology career.

evidence.quote: once Wela made a career for herself as a psychologist in 1965

events.text: Wela died; Imich was then alive and became a widower.
Edited the book Incredible Tales of the Paranormal.

evidence.quote: which was published by Bramble Books in 1995

events.label: founding
events.text: Formed the Anomalous Phenomena Research Center.

evidence.quote: He formed the Anomalous Phenomena Research Center in 1999

events.text: Began transferring his paranormal research records to University of Manitoba archives.

evidence.quote: In 2012 , he began to transfer the records of his research into the paranormal

events.label: health
events.text: Suffered a fall on or shortly before his 111th birthday.

evidence.quote: Imich suffered a fall either on or shortly before his 111th birthday

events.label: hospitalization
events.text: Spent his 111th birthday in Roosevelt Hospital, New York.

evidence.quote: with him spending his 111th birthday in the New York Citys Roosevelt Hospital

events.label: birthday
events.text: Belatedly celebrated his 111th birthday after leaving hospital.

evidence.quote: Imich belatedly celebrated his 111th birthday either in late April or early May 2014

events.label: record
events.text: Became the oldest living man after Arturo Licata's death.

evidence.quote: also became the oldest living man at age 111 after the death of almost 112-year-old Arturo Licata , of Italy , on April 24 , 2014

events.label: death
events.text: Died of natural causes in New York City, aged 111.

undated_mentions: Researched a medium, Matylda, for the Polish Society for Psychical Research (1920s–1930s)
Unpublished notes and photos from that research were lost during World War II
Fled with Wela to Soviet-occupied Białystok during World War II and worked as a chemist
Interned in a labor camp for the duration of the war after refusing Soviet citizenship
Took up chemistry to make a living after emigrating to the United States
Gave out the Imich prize for parapsychology research for several years
Served as president of the Anomalous Phenomena Research Center (undated)
Certified by Guinness World Records as the world's oldest living man (before June 2014)
